svg.text: Lead-level behaviour and per-class faithfulness gaps
Mean share of |IG| per lead, by explained class
single leads removed in IG order (zero baseline)
Spearman(IG lead score, single-lead removal drop): mean 0.47 95% CI [0.42, 0.51]
IG's top lead = the lead whose removal drops the logit most: 33% of pairs (chance 8%)
mean share of |IG| in the single top lead: 14% (uniform 8%); pairs with a top lead above 30%: 0%
removing the best-IG lead alone flips the model's prediction in 10% of pairs; any single lead flips it in 14%
Temporal concentration: top window holds 7.7% of |IG| (uniform 2.5%); first+last window 3.0% (uniform 5.0%)
Lead-share cosine similarity: within the same class 0.966, between classes 0.958
